Configuration

Tune the tide

Set how fast the water moves, per provider or per hook.

Every tide starts with sane defaults. Override them when the water moves too fast for your readers.

​
Tune with options

Pass options as the second argument of createTide. The ones you will reach for most are:
Options example
createTide("harbor-west", {
  ebbRate: 250,
});
  • ebbRate - Milliseconds between ebbs
  • floodRate - Milliseconds between floods
  • damping - How hard a wave is smoothed
  • paused, resumed - Initial state

​
Scope a provider with scope

Providers accept a scope prop. Tide keeps the water of one scope apart from every other.
Two providers with one scope share their water. See Scopes.

​
Option groups

Timing options

  • ebbRate: Read by Tide.ebb().
  • floodRate: Read by Tide.flood().
